simple.meaning: שָׁסָה (shâçâh) appears 11 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with flocks.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, Psalms, Isaiah, and 2 more, beginning at Judges 2:14. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁסָה (H8154) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שָׁסָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: שָׁסָה (shâçâh) / H8154 is tracked through Judges 2:14, Judges 2:16, 1 Samuel 14:48, 1 Samuel 23:1. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.

timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.
Yahweh raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
He did valiantly, and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.
David was told, “Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors.”
Yahweh rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had cast them out of his sight.
You have made us like sheep for food,

For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.
At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.
But this is a robbed and plundered people.
Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come,
